senses.sense_definition: A large, destructive fire that spreads over a wide area.

examples.text: The firefighters struggled for hours to contain the massive <w>conflagration</w> that destroyed the historic district.
Dry weather conditions turned the small brush fire into a dangerous <w>conflagration</w>.

senses.sense_definition: A large-scale, intense conflict or war.

examples.text: Diplomats worked tirelessly to prevent the regional dispute from escalating into a global <w>conflagration</w>.
The fragile peace treaty was shattered, plunging the entire continent into a devastating <w>conflagration</w>.

senses.sense_definition: A situation characterized by intense, overwhelming passion or emotion.

examples.text: Their brief romance quickly turned into a <w>conflagration</w> of jealousy and desire.
The public debate became a <w>conflagration</w> of anger and conflicting opinions.
